structural_validation.validator: Pydantic v2 LiteratureAtom plus supplied JSON Schema Draft 2020-12

extraction_limitations: The uploaded PDF contains the 10-page main article but not the online supplementary material; supplementary figures were atomized only from the authors' main-text descriptions.
Exact point estimates were not digitized from Figures 3-5; figure-based atoms preserve qualitative patterns and thresholds explicitly stated in the text.
No human reviewer independently verified the extraction; all atoms are marked needs_review.

The atom schema has no dedicated fields for publication-level metadata, code repositories, or complex multi-metric figure results, so those details are represented in a separate metadata file or as canonical statements and tags.
No adverse-event atoms were created because the paper is a methodological evaluation rather than a clinical safety study.
